name: Applied Algebraic Geometry & Tensors
description: Applied algebraic geometry is the mathematical field that studies nonlinear algebra (algebraic geometry) and multilinear algebra (tensors).

name: Topological Data Analysis
description: Topological data analysis is the mathematical field that studies the shape of data. By computing topological invariants of data, one obtains a multi-scale geometric descriptor.

name: Software & Computational Mathematics
description: Applicable mathematics requires algorithms. We build computational tools to make theory practical and open source.

name: Dynamical Systems & Mathematical Modeling
description: Mathematical models describe and predict the evolution of natural phenomena. Dynamical systems is the mathematical field to study how such systems behave under different conditions.

name: Identifiability, Statistics, & AI
description: Combining mathematical models and noisy data requires statistics and AI. Identifiablity is necessary for well-posed parameter estimation.

name: Biological Networks
description: Molecules, their interactions and feedbacks can be modeled as graphs and analyzed with network theory. Such chemical reaction networks can also be described as polynomial dynamical systems.

name: Morphology & Spatial Biology
description: To study biological shape (morphology) and spatial organization of cells in tissues, we use geometry and topology to complement existing approaches.

name: Omics
description: Modern genomics experiments describe the activity of every gene, RNA or every protein in a tissue sample. We take a mathematical perspective to understand transcriptomics and proteomics.

name: Oncology
description: Cancer disrupts cellular processes and tissue homeostatsis. We study and quantify how tumour cells rewire their signaling, alter blood vessel growth and change tissue organisation.

name: Immunology
description: The immune system plays an important role to maintain health and dysfunctions in many diseases. We study the molecules, signalling pathways and immune cells in diseases ranging from cancer, lupus and covid.

name: Neuroscience
description: The brain is a mysterious organ, encompassing structural and functional networks. The shape and connectivity of neuronal cells and circuits benefit from mathematics to understand its complexity and predict behavior.

name: From Coral to Contagions
description: Many other scientific applications, including the evolution of coral reefs, music identification and social contagions, benefit from algebraic, network and topological analysis.
